entities.summary: Omari Rasulala Spellman is an American-Lebanese professional basketball player for Beijing Ducks of the Chinese Basketball Association (CBA). He played college basketball for the Villanova Wildcats, winning a national championship in 2018. Spellman was drafted 30th overall by the Atlanta Hawks in the 2018 NBA draft.
